name: pokemon-go-event-webhook
description: Self-hosted Pokémon GO event scraper with Discord webhook posts, Discord sign-in, a signup page and an admin panel, on Cloudflare Workers + D1.

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply pokemon-go-events --local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply pokemon-go-events --remote && wrangler deploy
